svg.title: Four scenarios between Wero and the digital euro
svg.desc: Wero and the digital euro can produce duplication, public cannibalisation, integration or a common acceptance layer.
svg.text: Four possible paths towards payment sovereignty

g.text: 1. DUPLICATION
Two apps, two rails, two certifications
Wero and the public sector each fund acceptance.
Fixed costs double and volumes fragment.
RISK: costs rise when scale remains low.
2. PUBLIC CANNIBALISATION
Legal tender + mandatory acceptance
The digital euro competes with Wero for the same use cases.
Public infrastructure absorbs scheme and processing.
RISK: weakening the private European champion.
3. INTEGRATION
Wero becomes the interface
One wallet, bank account or digital euro as funding source.
Wero keeps brand, UX, loyalty and services.
CONDITION: clear sharing of fees, data and liability.
4. COMMON ACCEPTANCE LAYER
One open rail for several solutions
NFC, QR, APIs and shared standards.
Common rails reduce Wero's network investment.
The merchant can choose the lowest-cost rail.
ECB PROMISE: turn public cost into a common good.

svg.text: Governance determines the outcome alongside technology.
Sources: EPI, ECB Fit in the Ecosystem. l0g synthesis.
